package.name: rover_control
package.description:
Control and perception for the autonomous rover, built around one integration point: geometry_msgs/Twist on /cmd_vel.
Teleop: keyboard_node publishes /cmd_vel; fake_motor_node subscribes and converts it into simulated left/right motor values (swappable for an Arduino serial bridge with no other changes).
Autonomous perception pipeline (three nodes): camera_node -> /camera/image/compressed (Pi camera / USB / video file) perception_node -> /perception/detection (YOLO: which object, where) action_node -> /cmd_vel (steer the wheels toward it)
Because action_node drives /cmd_vel, the same motor path serves both teleop and autonomous modes.
RASPBERRY PI FLAVOUR: this ros2_pi copy adds arduino_bridge_node, which writes the left/right values to a real Arduino over serial (pyserial), and defaults the launch file to the Pi camera + real motors. odometry_node dead-reckons pose from /cmd_vel onto /odom.
